name: Aura: Fuming Cloak
descr:
Granted by [Nightmare'S Lament](/item/nightmare-s-lament-howl-of-the-wild)

The *nightmare's lament* continually vents thick, black smoke that creates concealment in a 15-foot aura around the gun's wielder.

name: Effect: All Are One
descr: The area of bioluminescent maelstrom and the reach of their tentacle Strike increase by 10 feet, to a maximum of an additional 30 feet.

name: Effect: Amphisbaena Spittle
descr:
Granted by [Amphisbaena Spittle](/item/amphisbaena-spittle-howl-of-the-wild)

The target cannot be flanked until the start of its next turn.

name: Effect: Animal Blind
descr:
Granted by [Animal Blind](/item/animal-blind-howl-of-the-wild)

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to Hide.

name: Effect: Bolstering Croak
descr:
Granted by [Whip Tongue Sling](/item/whip-tongue-sling-howl-of-the-wild)

Allies gain a +1 status bonus to saves against fear effects.

name: Effect: Catch Pole
descr:
Granted by [Catch Pole](/item/catch-pole-howl-of-the-wild), [Giant Catch Pole](/item/giant-catch-pole-howl-of-the-wild), [Superior Catch Pole](/item/superior-catch-pole-howl-of-the-wild)

A creature [grabbed](/condition/grabbed-player-core) by the catch pole receives a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls when Striking with an unarmed attack.

name: Effect: Caustic Jabs
descr:
Granted by [Ankhrav Duster](/item/ankhrav-duster-howl-of-the-wild)

Your Strikes with the *ankhrav duster* deal an additional 1d6 persistent acid damage.

name: Effect: Change Shape (Werecreature)
descr:
Granted by [Change Shape](/action/change-shape-monster-core)

You transform into your hybrid or animal shape. Your equipment transforms with you and continues to provide bonuses, but your animal shape cannot use weapons, shields, or other held items and cannot use manipulate actions. You gain a movement speed, unarmed attacks, and potentially other abilities based on your werecreature type. These unarmed attacks are in the brawling group. You can Dismiss the effect to return to your humanoid shape, and you resume your humanoid shape automatically if you're reduced to 0 Hit Points.

name: Effect: Conduct
descr:
The concert frog and all allies within 60 feet gain one of the following three effects until the beginning of the concert frog's next turn.

**Red** Grants a +10-foot status bonus to their Speeds.
**Blue** Grants a +1 status bonus to AC and Fortitude saving throws.
**Yellow** Allies gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and deal an additional 1d4 sonic damage on successful melee Strikes.

name: Effect: Deceptive Heads
descr: The number of deceptive heads the tyrafdir currently has.

name: Effect: Echolocation
descr:
Granted by [Echolocation](/feat/echolocation-howl-of-the-wild)

You can use hearing as a precise sense with a range of 40 feet.

name: Effect: Feel No Pain
descr: The swarm gains 10 temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Force of Nature (Silver Damage)
descr:
Granted by [Force Of Nature](/feat/force-of-nature-howl-of-the-wild)

Your fast healing deactivates.

name: Effect: Fox's Wager
descr: The target gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and a +5 status bonus to damage against constructs, objects, and structures constructed by humanoids. It also gains a +2 status bonus to Stealth checks against humanoids.

name: Effect: Fuming Cloak
descr:
Granted by [Nightmare'S Lament](/item/nightmare-s-lament-howl-of-the-wild)

Everything within the aura is concealed by thick, black smoke.

name: Effect: Grab Debris
descr:
The scroungefeather gains access to the listed abilities until it uses Tossed Scraps to discard the debris or until it Releases the debris. The scroungefeather can't use its beak attack while it is using its beak to Grab Debris.

**Armor scrap** The scroungefeather gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC.

**Shattered blade** The scroungefeather gains a broken blade melee Strike with a +12 attack modifier that deals 2d10+6 slashing damage.

**Unexploded bomb** When the scroungefeather throws this with Tossed Scraps, all the damage is fire damage, and the bomb also deals 3 fire splash damage.

**Faulty wand** The scroungefeather gains a magic bolt ranged Strike with a +14 attack modifier that deals 2d6+6 force damage.

name: Effect: Grasp of the Deep
descr: The creature gains cold weakness 10 and take a –2 status penalty to Fortitude saves.

name: Effect: Hopeful Athamaru
descr:
Granted by [Hopeful Athamaru](/heritage/hopeful-athamaru-howl-of-the-wild)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against fear.

name: Effect: Hydra Mutagen
descr:
Granted by [Hydra Mutagen](/item/hydra-mutagen-howl-of-the-wild)

**Benefit** You gain all-around vision and a +3 item bonus to all Intelligence- and Wisdom-based skill checks.

**Drawback** You are clumsy 1.

name: Effect: Kettle Up (Boiling)
descr: You take a –2 penalty to Perception checks to hear sources other than the flynkett.

name: Effect: Lightning Rod
descr:
Granted by [Fulmination Fang](/item/fulmination-fang-howl-of-the-wild)

The next melee Strike you make with the *fulmination fang* deals an additional 1d6 electricity damage.

name: Effect: Luminous Lure

Granted by [Mamlambo Scale](/item/mamlambo-scale-howl-of-the-wild)

name: Effect: Mammoth Land Star Limbs

name: Effect: Mentor of Legends
descr:
Granted by [Mentor Of Legends](/feat/mentor-of-legends-howl-of-the-wild)

The target gains temporary Hit Points equal to half your level.

name: Effect: Misty Chill
descr:
Granted by [Arctic Worm Chitin Shield](/item/arctic-worm-chitin-shield-howl-of-the-wild)

You Raise the Shield and you gain resistance 5 to cold.

name: Effect: Noxious Exhalation

name: Effect: Ommatophoric Mutagen
descr:
Granted by [Ommatophoric Mutagen](/item/ommatophoric-mutagen-howl-of-the-wild)

**Benefit** You gain all-around vision, a +2 item bonus to visual Perception checks, and low-light vision if you don't already have it.

**Drawback** You take a –2 penalty to saving throws against effects that have the [visual](/trait/visual) trait.

name: Effect: Paired Spikes

name: Effect: Pallesthetic Mutagen
descr:
Granted by [Pallesthetic Mutagen](/item/pallesthetic-mutagen-howl-of-the-wild)

**Benefit** You gain precise echolocation out to 40 feet, imprecise tremorsense out to 60 feet, and a +2 item bonus to Perception checks using either of these senses.

**Drawback** You are blinded.

name: Effect: Portable Animal Blind
descr:
Granted by [Portable Animal Blind](/item/portable-animal-blind-howl-of-the-wild)

name: Effect: Portents of the Haruspex
descr:
Granted by [Portents Of The Haruspex](/feat/portents-of-the-haruspex-howl-of-the-wild)

Roll 1d12 to determine the damage type. The next time before the end of your next turn that you or your allies deals that damage type to an enemy, that enemy has weakness equal to your level against that damage.

name: Effect: Proud Mentor
descr:
Granted by [Proud Mentor](/feat/proud-mentor-howl-of-the-wild)

name: Effect: Repel Ambient Magic

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against the next magical attack, cantrip, or spell that targets you. This bonus increases to +2 at 12th level.

name: Effect: Shielding Wave

name: Effect: Siphon Torment

name: Effect: Song of the Skies
descr: You gain a fly speed of 60 ft.

name: Effect: Static Field
descr: Plant creatures gain 5 temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Turn Aside Ambient Magic
descr:
Granted by [Turn Aside Ambient Magic](/action/turn-aside-ambient-magic-howl-of-the-wild)

Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. You gain resistance against the chosen damage type equal to half your level.

name: Effect: Viperous Elixir (Greater)
descr:
Granted by [Viperous Elixir (Greater)](/item/viperous-elixir-greater-howl-of-the-wild)

You gain a fangs unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. You gain a +3 item bonus to unarmed attack and damage rolls when you Strike with your fangs or another bite attack.

name: Effect: Viperous Elixir (Lesser)
descr:
Granted by [Viperous Elixir (Lesser)](/item/viperous-elixir-lesser-howl-of-the-wild)

You gain a fangs unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. You gain a +1 item bonus to unarmed attack and damage rolls when you Strike with your fangs or another bite attack.

name: Effect: Viperous Elixir (Moderate)
descr:
Granted by [Viperous Elixir (Moderate)](/item/viperous-elixir-moderate-howl-of-the-wild)

You gain a fangs unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. You gain a +2 item bonus to unarmed attack and damage rolls when you Strike with your fangs or another bite attack.

name: Effect: Watery Form
descr:
Granted by [Orm Choker](/item/orm-choker-howl-of-the-wild)

You gain a swim Speed of 45 feet, and you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks in water.

name: Effect: Web
descr: The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds.

name: Effect: Wemmuth Trinket
descr:
Granted by [Wemmuth Trinket](/item/wemmuth-trinket-howl-of-the-wild)

Creatures who fail or critically fail their Reflex saves against *entangling flora* also take piercing damage equal to the spell's rank.

name: Effect: Wild Mimic Dedication

Granted by [Wild Mimic Dedication](/feat/wild-mimic-dedication-howl-of-the-wild)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your saving throws against the next attack or ability that the subject of your Recall Knowledge targets you with.

name: Spell Effect: Albatross Curse
descr:
Granted by [Albatross Curse](/spell/albatross-curse-howl-of-the-wild).

You and allies within 30 feet of the target gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attacks against the target.

name: Spell Effect: Albatross Curse (Circumstance Bonus)
descr:
Granted by [Albatross Curse](/spell/albatross-curse-howl-of-the-wild)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attacks against the target of the Albatross Curse.

name: Spell Effect: Albatross Curse (Critical Failure)
descr:
Granted by [Albatross Curse](/spell/albatross-curse-howl-of-the-wild)

You must roll twice and take the worse result on your next Will save.

descr:
Granted by [Albatross Curse](/spell/albatross-curse-howl-of-the-wild)

You must roll twice and take the worse result on your next Will save.

name: Spell Effect: Animal Form (Crab)
descr:
Granted by [Animal Form](/spell/animal-form-player-core)

You transform yourself into a Medium animal battle form. While in this form, you gain the [animal](/trait/animal) trait. You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:

AC = 16 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.5 temporary Hit Points.Low-light vision and imprecise scent 30 feet.One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +9, and your damage bonus is +1. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the [Enfeebled](/condition/enfeebled-player-core) condition, for example). If your unarmed attack bonus is higher, you can use it instead.Athletics modifier of +9, unless your own modifier is higher.

You also gain specific abilities based on the type of animal you choose:

**Crab**

Speed 25 feet, swim Speed 15 feet;**Melee** 1 big claw, **Damage** 2d8 piercing;**Melee** 1 little claw (agile), **Damage** 2d4 piercing.can breathe in water and in air.

---

**Heightened (3rd)** You instead gain 10 temporary HP, AC = 17 + your level, attack modifier +14, damage bonus +5, and Athletics +14.

**Heightened (4th)** Your battle form is Large and your attacks have 10-foot reach. You must have enough space to expand into or the spell is lost. You instead gain 15 temporary HP, AC = 18 + your level, attack modifier +16, damage bonus +9, and Athletics +16.

**Heightened (5th)** Your battle form is Huge and your attacks have 15-foot reach. You must have enough space to expand into or the spell is lost. You instead gain 20 temporary HP, AC = 18 + your level, attack modifier +18, damage bonus +7 and double the number of damage dice, and Athletics +20.

name: Spell Effect: Canopy Crawler
descr:
Granted by [Canopy Crawler](/spell/canopy-crawler-howl-of-the-wild)

You gain a climb Speed equal to your highest Speed.

name: Spell Effect: Claws of the Otter
descr:
Granted by [Claws Of The Otter](/spell/claws-of-the-otter-howl-of-the-wild)

You gain a +1 status bonus to Athletics checks to Swim and you gain a claws unarmed attack. They're an agile, finesse, unarmed attack that deals slashing damage and additional cold damage.

name: Spell Effect: Distracting Decoy
descr:
Granted by [Distracting Decoy](/spell/distracting-decoy-howl-of-the-wild)

**Failure** The creature is off-guard until the start of your next turn.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature also takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attacks while it's off-guard.

name: Spell Effect: Hidebound
descr:
Granted by [Hidebound](/spell/hidebound-howl-of-the-wild)

You gain resistance to physical damage, except adamantine, until the beginning of its next turn.

name: Spell Effect: Hippocampus Retreat
descr:
Granted by [Hippocampus Retreat](/spell/hippocampus-retreat-howl-of-the-wild)

If you already have a swim Speed, you can Swim up to your Speed with a +10-foot circumstance bonus. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC against reactions triggered by this movement.

name: Spell Effect: Imitate Fauna
descr:
Granted by [Imitate Fauna](/spell/imitate-fauna-howl-of-the-wild)

name: Spell Effect: Keen Smell

Granted by [Keen Smell](/spell/keen-smell-howl-of-the-wild)

name: Spell Effect: Murmuration
descr:
Granted by [Murmuration](/spell/murmuration-howl-of-the-wild)

You take a –2 status penalty to your attack roll or hostile skill check.

descr:
Granted by [Snake Fangs](/spell/snake-fangs-howl-of-the-wild)

You gain a fangs unarmed attack. They're a finesse, grapple, unarmed attack that deals piercing damage and extra poison damage.

name: Spell Effect: Spirit of the Beast
descr:
Granted by [Spirit Of The Beast](/spell/spirit-of-the-beast-howl-of-the-wild)

Select from one of the following aspects.

**Aspect of Might:** You gain a status bonus to Athletics checks, Intimidation checks to Demoralize, and Fortitude saves.**Aspect of Swiftness:** You gain a status bonus to Acrobatics checks, Stealth checks to Hide or Sneak, and Reflex saves.**Aspect of Insight:** You gain a status bonus to Perception checks to Seek, Survival checks to Sense Direction or Track, and Will saves.

name: Spell Effect: Sting of the Sea
descr:
Granted by [Sting Of The Sea](/spell/sting-of-the-sea-howl-of-the-wild)

The target takes a –2 penalty to Perception checks involving vision.

name: Stance: Claw Stance
descr:
Granted by [Claw Stance](/action/claw-stance-howl-of-the-wild)

The only Strikes you can make are frenzied claw unarmed attacks. These deal 1d6 slashing damage, are in the brawling group, and have the agile, finesse, grapple, unarmed, and versatile piercing traits.

name: Stance: Stretching Reach
descr:
Granted by [Stretching Reach](/feat/stretching-reach-howl-of-the-wild)

When you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, the weapon gains a reach of 10 feet.

name: Stance: Talon Stance
descr:
Granted by [Talon Stance](/action/talon-stance-howl-of-the-wild)

The only Strikes you can make are spinning talon unarmed attacks. These deal 1d8 slashing damage, are in the brawling group, and have the finesse, sweep, and [unarmed](/trait/unarmed) traits. You don't need a free hand to use spinning talon strikes.
